items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: I was not a member of it then. The band under the direction of P.M. Logan, we call him Hotze for a nickname. Professor P.M. Logan, a marvelous musician.

ctx.x: This band also was playing on the Midway at the Buffalo Exposition in 1902. I was not a member of it then. The band under the direction of P.M. Logan, we call him Hotze for a nickname. Professor P.M. Logan, a marvelous musician.
How big is the band? You never mentioned how big it is.
